title: Los Alamos insider: surfaces that solid objects pass through
summary: Mario Woods tells of Los Alamos insider: surfaces that solid objects pass through, about unspecified at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh, metal surfaces were um could be manipulated to like put things through, in or out

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by non-human beings, relays what someone connected to Los Alamos, the US government weapons lab in New Mexico, told him. According to that person, there are metal surfaces that can be manipulated so that solid things pass through them, in or out. If true, it would point to technology far beyond anything known.
